name: grepmesh-search
description: Bounded mesh search for Codex and ZCode, with an explicit rg-first rule for known local paths.

interface.shortDescription: Bounded mesh search, with rg-first local routing.
interface.longDescription: Use GrepMesh for unknown locations and cross-host search. For a known local checkout or path, use rg because it is usually more context-efficient.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use rg for known local paths; use GrepMesh only for unknown locations, cross-host search, or configured mesh scopes.
